answer: Because the terrace decay is applied at each close, the grove audit reveals the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 22% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool therefore watches its influence decay while paying the canyon fee to keep them eligible. Honest users pay that once, farms 37 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
